title: sessions list
description: promptscope sessions list --json. Rows are newest update first. Subagents and temporary sessions are omitted unless the matching flag is set.

session.description: One session row. id matches promptscope-gpui scan.rs: <source>:<session>, for example grok:<id>, kiro-ide:<id>, kiro-cli:<id>, omp:<id>, pi:<id>, devin:<id>, dsh:<id>.

id.description: Window id <source>:<session>. The source is the AgentSource raw value.

title.description: Title from session metadata. This can be user text. The transcript is not included.

cwd.description: Working directory recorded in the log. Empty when the log has none.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC, or null when the log has no creation time.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC, or null when the log has no update time.

locator.description: Absolute path of the session directory or log file.

transcriptBytes.description: Size of the transcript file in bytes, not the measured text.

isTemporary.description: True when cwd is under /tmp or /var/folders.

contextPercent.description: Recorded context percent, or null when the scan did not see one.
